user.description: Database username (non-secret, matches the Postgres source form)

port.description: Database port. sqlconnect-go unmarshals this into Port int, so the integer form is the only one that survives a sync; the string form is a transitional allowance for the rudder-iac fixture (and the single production row it created) that still sends "5432". It is removed by a follow-up PR once this schema is released and rudderlabs/rudder-iac#827 has updated that fixture. Both forms are bounded to 1-65535.

sslMode.description: SSL mode, passed through to lib/pq unchanged by sqlconnect-go. The set matches the modes rudder-lookout accepts for Postgres (POSTGRES_SSLMODES, src/lib/postgres-connection.ts); its own default is `require`.
